text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, in the academy's central 
courtyard...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Haa... Couldn't beat my time today 
either... I've hit a slump... haven't 
I...?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(It's always like this... I just can't 
take that one last, crucial step...)

text_block_list.name: Delivery Guy
text_block_list.text: Hnnngrrrrgh...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "...Waaaah!? Are you okay!?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mister! Let me help you with that! If you 
push yourself too hard, you'll hurt your 
back!

text_block_list.name: Delivery Guy
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, young lady... Back in my 
younger days, I could carry these without 
breaking a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Kita-san... What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A delivery guy was bringing in the new 
training equipment, and it looked like he 
was having a really tough time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I just need to take it to the gym, right? 
...Alright, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... umm...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I'll help too...!

text_block_list.name: Delivery Guy
text_block_list.text:
Whew, you saved me! Thank you, strong 
young ladies!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That man looked so happy! —Ah, kindness 
makes the world go round. Helping folks 
really brightens the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, Cheval-chan! Let's try out 
this new training equipment right away!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh... No, it's fine. I'm... perfectly 
happy with what I'm used to—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(What's most important for taking that 
extra step forward...? Is it not just leg 
strength... but 'resolve' like 
Kita-san's...?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-san. I-I'll try it too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From this day on, Cheval Grand's running 
became even sharper!
